title: Switching mode mid-chat
what: Internal, for the apps: step2388 on the team's research build, a chat switching between k3 and k6 with the memory cleared (the team's default) or kept from the other path. Part 2 scores five-turn chats in both arms; Part 1 measures how far the next tokens drift. Not a row of the board's tables, not in the whitepaper.
